name: Motion studies
notes: One clip per item. 'from' is the still the motion starts from; forge-images publishes these under renders/<set>/. The committed seed.png is a placeholder so `plan` works out of the box. The forgemaster clips run on GitHub's CPU runners (render.yml): the still is forge-images renders/portraits/portraits-forgemaster-s1103.png, 3:4 on the 32 grid: the smoke at 288x384 (14 s/step measured), the 10 s clip at 384x512.

seed-drift.prompt: slow ember drift upward past the subject, faint heat haze, camera pushes in

forgemaster-smoke.prompt: A hooded figure in a dark iron mask with round glowing orange eyes holds a lit candle on a brass dish. The candle flame flickers gently, a thin ribbon of grey smoke curls upward and drifts to the left, the orange eyes pulse softly. The figure breathes slowly and the red cloak shifts slightly. The camera holds still with a very slow push in. Dark oil painting, warm candlelight, muted background.
